title: TenancyPartnerUpdatedPayload
description: Payload of `tenancy.partner.updated` version 1: a partner's profile, legal identity, kind, contacts, logo or banner changed. The envelope's `partner_id` is the partner. The payload names the members that changed, never their values (an address or a phone number never travels in an event); read the partner for them. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The partner that changed, the same value as the envelope's `partner_id`.

changed.description: The names of the partner's members that changed, never their values.
